description: MUTATES Dayze Contacts. Patch one existing contact the user owns (person_id UUID required). Optional fields: name, is_favorite, tier, relationships (multi-value), context_tags (Work/Personal/Family/custom), legacy relationship, notes, birthday. Rejects unknown fields. Does not create or delete contacts. Rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

birthday.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM-DD / --MM-DD (year unknown). Null/empty clears

context_tags.description: Contexts such as Work, Personal, Family, plus custom tags

is_favorite.description: Favorite flag. Favorites (and VIP) appear in get_context_pack inner_circle

name.description: Rename contact (also refreshes URL slug). Prefer this over create+merge for spelling fixes

notes.description: Replaces people.notes (does not append). Empty or null clears

person_id.description: UUID of a person the authenticated user owns

preserve_old_name_as_alias.description: When renaming, keep the previous name as a former_name alias (default true)

relationship.description: Relationship label (friend, sister, …). Empty or null clears

relationships.description: Who they are to the user, in primary-first order (for example Friend + Client)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

tier.description: Relationship priority. VIP stays in inner_circle even when not favorited

name: update_person

changed.description: Changed fields with before and after values.

person.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

title: Update Contact (CRM write)
